description: This file defines the 'VerticalXAxisRenderer' class, a specialized renderer for vertical X axes in charting components. It overrides methods for initialization, formatting, and drawing of the axis, including tick marks, labels, and axis titles, specifically for charts of type Bar2D within the PdfSharp.Charting.Renderers namespace.

classes.name: VerticalXAxisRenderer
classes.description: A specialized renderer for vertical X axes in chart rendering, handling axis initialization, layout, and drawing for 2D bar charts.

methods.name: VerticalXAxisRenderer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the renderer with parameters.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Prepares renderer info for the X axis based on chart data before rendering.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Calculates space and dimensions needed for rendering axis components like labels and titles.

methods.name: Draw
methods.description: Performs the actual drawing of tick marks, labels, axis line, and title on the graphics context.

methods.name: CalculateXAxisValues
methods.description: Sets the minimum, maximum, and tick intervals for the axis based on series data.

methods.name: InitXValues
methods.description: Initializes the data points (XValues) for the axis, either from chart data or default numeric sequence.

methods.name: GetTickMarkPos
methods.description: Calculates the positions for minor and major tick marks based on axis configuration.
